bay_wall_sweep.rule: every moving instance (rigid engine/ring/horn/pushrod groups with their kinematics and the flexible hoses FD-07/BL-04) r <= R_bore - min_clear (lead CHANGELOG 182 (5) / 188 (2): 140 mm bore, >= 1.0 mm, i.e. r <= 69.0 mm) at every tilt 0..stop (1 deg steps, incl. 7 and 8 deg) in n_dir directions plus the stop polygon of build.pose_list; signed per instance; r = distance from the bay (neutral engine) axis
bay_wall_sweep.signed: clear_to_bore_mm = R_bore - r_ub (negative = inside the wall); ok = clear_to_bore_mm >= min_clear
